category_name: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith
title: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith - Hisn al-Muslim 133
arabic:
يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ.
يَنْتَهِي عَمَّا شك فِيهِ.
translation: I seek refuge in Allah. (Then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about.)

category_name: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith
title: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith - Hisn al-Muslim 134
translation: I believe in Allah and His Messengers.

category_name: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith
title: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith - Hisn al-Muslim 135
arabic: هُوَ الأوَّلُ، وَالآخِـرُ، وَالظّـاهِـرُ، وَالْبـاطِـنُ، وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَلـيم
transliteration: Huwa 'l-Awwalu wa 'l-Ākhir, waẓ-Ẓāhiru wal-Bāṭin, wa huwa bikulli shay'in 'Alīm
translation: He is the First and the Last, the Most High and the Most Near. And He is the Knower of all things. (Recite the Ayat in Arabic)
reference: Al-Hadid 57:3, Abu Dawud 4/329. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/962
